policy: Research distinguishes historical sources, prior unverified specifications, canonical alternative-history definitions and conditional commercial inference. No sales values or new hardware compatibility are inferred. Source URLs support only the stated findings. No-impact findings live in evidence rather than spurious target entries.

tarbell_brochure.finding: Manufacturer describes programmed I/O, a bootstrap and standard-size single-density floppy drives; do not compare this controller alone with a complete FlexiDisk drive.

apple_disk_manual.finding: Apple installation manual separates the Disk II drive from its Apple II controller and software.

vector_mdos.finding: 1979 manufacturer guide distinguishes parallel Centronics and serial Diablo/Teletype printer paths and specifies Bitstreamer cabling, firmware and software configuration.

matrox_byte.finding: May 1978 product description distinguishes ALT-256 graphics from ALT-2480 alphanumeric display and describes their combined use.
matrox_byte.access: indexed period text; full PDF fetch exceeded tool size limit

swtpc_catalog.finding: Manufacturer catalogue separates CT-64 terminal, PR-40 printer and the host-specific peripheral families.
swtpc_catalog.access: catalogue index opened; detailed numerical claims not added

vt100_manual.finding: 1978 manufacturer guide documents ANSI and VT52 terminal programming. This is not evidence of the fictional TUI application API.
vt100_manual.access: indexed manual text; direct PDF request denied

ssg_advert.finding: SSG advertisement, printed page 5, offers General Ledger for 8080/Z80 CP/M-compatible systems. It does not establish a historical AION C port or the fictional 1978 launch date.

autodesk_letter.finding: July 1982 founder letter distinguishes AutoCAD development in C on 8086 and PL/I on Z80; the Artemis/ERA port is an alternative-history assumption.

model2_manual.finding: Tandy technical manual describes Model II-specific hardware and 32K/64K configurations. It does not document a historical FlexiBUS option.

ssm_io4.finding: SSM IO4 manual documents a native S-100 I/O board with UART/parallel hardware; no evidence of a FlexiBUS implementation.

northstar_manual.finding: Archive distinguishes original MDS-A single-density and later double-density manuals. No disk-format interchangeability is inferred from S-100 membership.
northstar_manual.access: manual inventory, not verification of every capacity

heath_h19.finding: 1979 Heath manufacturer manual identifies H19 as a video terminal. Terminal hardware is not the TUI application contract.
